degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives After the course you will be equipped the knowledge of Civil engineering discipline and professional training experience for engineers;Qualified ability for the work of planning, design, construction, management and research in civil engineering projects. Graduates will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies. Main Courses Advanced Math, Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Building materials, Material Mechanics, Structural Mechanics, Soil Mechanics & Foundation Engineering, Concrete Structure, Steel Structure, and Architecture Construction, Elementary Chinese, Survey of China, Intermediate Chinese, Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at China University of Petroleum - Beijing is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.The identity certificate of the guarantors charging your case in China For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or equivalent or above. Above avarage in academic performance in high schools; 2. HSK Level 4; 3. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 30 4. Be in good health; 5. Academic performance is above average and courses are 80% or above; 6. With basic English language ability
